title: Middle C
summary: One C is the landmark for the whole keyboard.

steps.title: Middle C
steps.body:
The C nearest the middle of the keyboard, usually right under the maker's name, is called **middle C**.

**Why it matters:** Middle C is the landmark everything else is measured from. Teachers, songbooks and band mates use it to say where on the keyboard to play.

steps.title: Middle C and its neighbours
steps.body: Middle C is in the centre, with a C on either side of it.

items.prompt: Play the lit key: the C just to the right of middle C.
Play the lit key: the C just to the left of middle C.

steps.title: Home base
steps.body: Put your right thumb on middle C and play a tune you know from there. Coming back to middle C will soon feel like coming home.

items.prompt: Find middle C without looking at the screen.
Is the lit key middle C?
